assessments.reasoning: Oracle PeopleBooks PDF cover and Chapter 1 bind the PeopleTools 8.60 October 2022 edition to SQR for PeopleSoft. The product chapter distinguishes the language from its companion tools and describes the language as used to access, manipulate, and report enterprise data.

Oracle PeopleBooks published a different July 2024 revision of the same PeopleTools 8.60 manual. Its distinct cover date and consistent language description support the editorial boundary as context for the October 2022 record.

The distinct July 2024 PeopleTools 8.60 PeopleCode manual is explicitly headed PeopleCode Language Reference. Sharing a PeopleTools distribution supplies no evidence of SQR and PeopleCode being the same language.

challenge.method: Test whether SQR names the PeopleSoft reporting product, a companion executable, or another PeopleTools language by comparing the October 2022 chapter’s separate itemization with the July 2024 SQR and PeopleCode cover pages.
challenge.results: The October manual identifies SQR as a programming language as well as describing the broader product. It lists Execute and Print separately. The PeopleCode title identifies a distinct language. The July SQR book is separately dated and carries no new claim about the October edition.

limitations: The registry name denotes the documented language in the PeopleSoft product. It covers neither SQR Execute and SQR Print nor extensions in other vendor or PeopleTools editions.
